name: Battle A Brainrot! [Early Access]
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Battle A Brainrot!

👍 Like the game & join the group for rewards!

⚔️ How to Play

🧠 Battle wild Brainrots to capture them
🎒 Buy items from shops to help you in battle
🏠 Place Brainrots in your plot to generate money
📈 Level up your Brainrots to make them stronger
🔥 Build a powerful team and defeat tougher Brainrots

Collect, train, and grow your Brainrot army to become the ultimate Brainrot Battler.

💸Earn money offline!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile & Tablet, and Console
